title: [Feature][MRV2][SpecDecode] Support block verification in MRV2
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Implement upstream block verification for Ascend Model Runner V2. Previously, `use_block_verification` was accepted but ignored.

- Reuse upstream cumulative probability-ratio and residual-mass kernels.
- Add block acceptance and prefix-scaled residual resampling to the NPU path.
- Preserve the upstream separation between acceptance and recovery random streams.
- Align placeholder recovery with upstream: bonus tokens and invalid draft tokens use the target distribution across standard, synthetic, and block verification modes.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. MRV2 now supports enabling block verification through:

`speculative_config={"rejection_sample_method": "block", ...}`

Placeholder recovery is also corrected for all verification modes.

### How was this patch tested?

Added or extended NPU tests covering:

- Target-distribution preservation and accepted-prefix extension.
- Prefix-scaled residuals and independent acceptance/recovery draws.
- Placeholder recovery across verification modes.
- Greedy consistency, variable-length requests, request-state mapping, vocabulary padding, and incompatible configurations.

Test commands:

pytest -sv \
  tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/ops/singlecard_ops/triton/test_rejection_sample_v2.py \
  tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/ops/singlecard_ops/triton/test_resample.py

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: I reviewed whether this change involves
  boundary conditions (e.g. empty input, single/zero element, min/max values,
  off-by-one, sequence-length limits, integer overflow). Where applicable, I
  added unit tests covering these edge cases in `tests/ut/` or `tests/e2e/`.
- [ ] **Regression test**: If this PR fixes a bug, I added a regression test
  that would fail without the fix.
- [x] **Error / failure path coverage**: I covered abnormal paths (exceptions,
  timeouts, out-of-range, division by zero) in addition to the happy path.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: New tests assert real behavior and are
  not written merely to satisfy CI.
- [ ] **Performance impact**: If this PR touches a performance-sensitive path,
  I attached benchmark results and added performance regression tests.
